causal.gate_status: Inputs only. Apply the prospectively frozen root plan; no inferred pass rule or p-values.
causal.aggregation: Mean each semantic order pair first. Case means then family means across related languages/categories. Translation rows are not independent topics.

saved_calibration.rule: Signed quantiles; per-coordinate pooled calibration carrier positions and separately task-specific final prediction positions
saved_calibration.warning: Synthetic corpus range, not universal physiological range; interventions unmatched in residual perturbation norm

historical_additive_comparison.caveat: Previous additive delta was about51.2times this synthetic carrier q90-q50 spread, not natural SDs. Additive prompt/first8 scope differs from carrier-only replacement; clamp displacement depends on original h. Context/position-specific descriptive comparison only.

semantic.suppression_control_operation: Target conditional h>q90 toq50 versus prespecified random all-carrier q10 downward proxies. Not operation- or residual-norm-matched.

frozen_gates.interpretation: Descriptive thresholds, not p-values or independent translations. No broad necessity or monosemanticity claim; absent high events limit suppression evidence.

definitions.lastmean: Pre scalar at final carrier token, not last generated token.
definitions.wholetextmax: Maximum signed pre scalar over logged story_start/end; fallback explicitly marked. Not maximum absolute value.
definitions.quantiles: Type7/linear quantiles of calibration carrier-token values only, pooled or language-specific. Never validation-derived.
definitions.direction: Positive/negative fractions use exact difference>0/<0; zero retained in denominator.
definitions.uncertainty: No p-values. Four core validation families; translations and category variants share their family.

limitations: Synthetic repeated templates and translation dependencies; not broad naturalistic pride detection.
Pooled per-token quantiles weight longer carriers/languages by token count; language-specific quantiles are separate diagnostics.
Range matching and residual-perturbation matching differ; this analyzer does not silently treat random controls as norm matched.
Incomplete semantic order pairs and missing baselines are retained but excluded from paired summaries.
No coefficient, event, family, language or condition selection from outcomes.
